description: A modular, stack-agnostic toolkit for AI coding agents to autonomously find, reproduce, and patch vulnerabilities.

written.description: Reads a codebase and its commit history, builds a threat model from them, and sends agents to chase each hypothesis it raises. It then tries to reproduce each finding in a sandbox and attacks its own patch to check the fix holds, working from source alone with no running target.

alive.last_commit_message:
Sync legacy suite with shipped contracts

Six test_suite.py cases asserted behavior the pipeline deliberately
retired, which made shipped features look unbuilt:

- domain tools: findings must cite files that exist under the jail
  (citation verifier), and unscoped get_findings reads are
  campaign-scoped rather than run-wide.
- model tiering: on_enter_status is exported empty; stamps fire from
  success-only completion callbacks.
- refusal sanitization: a ReviewVerdict refusal fails closed to
  false_positive with the "Fallback:" classifier contract, never to
  confirmed.
- graph edges: findings_gate joined the shipped graph;
  structural_index and the calibrator are deterministic and consume no
  scripted replies (the stray replies were being absorbed by a
  reviewer validation retry, hiding the queue misalignment);
  dynamic_confirmed requires sandbox_executed; a genuine
  false-positive verdict persists as false_positive.

Change-Id: I1a0e53538e0e1f4dbc110783b7ed996602dae712
